newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska in 2.8 bln skr U.S. deal.
newsitem.headline: Skanska in 2.8 bln skr U.S. deal.

text.p: Swedish construction company Skanska AB said on Friday it had signed its largest order ever in the U.S., worth 2.8 billion crowns.

"Skanska's U.S. subsidiary Slattery landed the contract for another segment of the gigantic highway extension called 'The Central Artery' in Boston, together with three other companies," Skanska said in a statement.
Slattery is sponsoring the consortium and accounts for one third of the project amount, it said.
The contract includes complex multi-level intersections and tunnels, it said.
It said the order raised Skanska's current total order stock in the U.S. to $3 billion.
